title: The last time anyone saw them alive #FranklinExpedition
subtitle: Frozen Passage · Short 2/6
caption:
July 1845, Baffin Bay. Two whaling ships meet HMS Erebus and HMS Terror moored to an iceberg. The whalers wave goodbye – and no European ever sees the ships or their crews alive again.

▶ Full documentary on the channel: Frozen Passage – The Lost Franklin Expedition
